native-commands.title: Native commands
native-commands.disclosure: Runs with full access on this session’s Runner, outside the thread sandbox.
native-commands.idleOnly: Commands are available after the original Codex session is idle and cleanup is confirmed.
native-commands.unsupported: The original Runner does not have a supported native command profile.
native-commands.timeoutHelp: Default: 1 hour. 0 stops immediately. Maximum: 1 hour.
native-commands.invalidTimeout: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3600.
native-commands.uncertain: The original action is uncertain. Read its status; the command will not be resent.
native-commands.backgroundScope: Only native processes owned by this session’s original active Codex execution.
native-commands.backgroundUnavailable: Original native inventory is unavailable. Read status to check again.
native-commands.backgroundOwnerLost: The original execution is no longer available for controls. Retained status does not prove process cleanup.
native-commands.backgroundUncertain: The original control is uncertain. Read status; it will not be resent.
native-commands.backgroundPending: Waiting for the original native target to disappear. Process cleanup is checked separately.
native-commands.backgroundAcknowledged: Native acknowledgment received; exit and cleanup remain separate
native-commands.backgroundEmpty: No original native background processes are listed.
native-commands.backgroundTruncated: Showing the first 16 KiB of output.
native-commands.backgroundConfirmScope: Stop the listed processes in this original native session. Independent product terminals keep running.
